hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Partition array into m contiguous subarrays such that the bitwise and of subarray j matches andValues[j].

hints.title: Prefix AND Monotonicity
hints.text: As elements are accumulated into a subarray, bitwise and can only eliminate set bits, taking at most thirty distinct values.

hints.title: State Memoization
hints.text: State dfs(i, j, current_and) tracks array index, target segment index, and running bitwise and. If current_and equals andValues[j], optionally complete the segment.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: State space bounded by logarithm of maximum value.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exponential subset branching without bitwise compression times out.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Leverage the logarithmic bound on distinct prefix bitwise and values.
